geometry_review.sampling: local planar approximation, <=1 m intervals; city row polyline
geometry_review.restriction_relation_scan: No staged restriction relation references either arm; this does not establish current turn signs.
geometry_review.disposition: Both eastbound; not an opposing split. Equal mapped through permission supports either as one source-inferred car path; exact designated lane remains uncertain.

access_parity.way_tags: Both highway=residential, oneway=yes, oneway:bicycle=yes, maxheight=11 ft, same name; no other access or direction tags. Ordinary cars travel forward (east), not reverse (west), on both. Height limit applies to both.
access_parity.approach_exit: Both share west endpoint 261212855 and east endpoint 261294463. West approach 194803327 is eastbound; east continuation 458591864 is eastbound. Both connect identically to Lakewood at endpoints, 24089277 and 976197309 respectively.
access_parity.interior_movements: Both have one attachment to same undirected service alley 207297313 at distinct nodes: 12233753877 on 458591863 and 2174917836 on 1178008329; other interior nodes have no highway attachments. The exact off-route junctions are distinct, so this is not a claim that every physical turning movement is identical.
access_parity.relation_scan: All 5,723 staged type=restriction relations scanned for members matching either arm, every arm node, approach, exit, Lakewood endpoint ways and alley. No matching relations. Absence does not verify current restrictions.
access_parity.through_path_conclusion: Both mapped arms give the same source-inferred eastbound through permission and prohibit westbound through travel. Shorter 1178008329 may represent one mapped car path without establishing the sole designated or actual lane; closer 458591863 remains equally plausible. Field review needed.
